QUOTE: Write paths are refused by `stale_code_refusal` (`freshness.py:531`), and `force` deliberately does not bypass that refusal.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that write paths are refused (not merely warned) and that force does not bypass it. It also says the server refuses to auto-refresh when the code axis is stale. That covers the refusal that sits ahead of the build decision, so a force flag cannot override it.
